title: Mattel Marvel Plush, Dancing Groot English-Speaking Soft Toy, 13 Inches Tall with Sound, Phrases, Music & Dance Moves
writeup: The Mattel Marvel Dancing Groot plush is a 13-inch talking soft toy with sound, phrases, music and dance moves, now $11.99 new. Walmart sells the same Groot at $23.50, so this price is about 48 percent lower. The price was seen on Nov 27 at 3:04 PM ET.
